newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Trans Capital shares debut at 11.0 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Trans Capital shares debut at 11.0 rgt.

text.p: Shares of Malaysia's Trans Capital Holding Bhd made their market debut at 11.0 ringgit against an offer price of 5.70 ringgit.
The investment holding firm with subsidiaries in electrical and electronic product manufacturing offered 1.499 million news shares and 7.613 milion vendor shares in its initial public offering.
Around three minutes into the opening, the stock was at 10.20 ringgit on volume of 229,000 shares traded. It has traded between 10.20 and 11.50.
Trans Capital estimated net profit of 16.83 million ringgit for the year ended December 31, 1996, or net earnings per share of 42.07 cents.
At 11.0 ringgit, price-to-earnings ratio is 26.1 times.
